headline: Please stop asking me when the AI bubble will pop
summary: The author is frustrated by persistent questions about the AI bubble bursting. They state predicting market timing is impossible for individuals. If they knew, they'd make a life-changing market bet.

headline: Canva announces changes and layoffs affecting 22 percent of its staff
summary: Canva is implementing significant changes impacting 1,271 employees, 22% of its workforce. Some staff will face role changes or relocation to centralized hubs. The restructuring also involves saying goodbye to many teammates.

headline: Sonos adds new Presets and prepares for 27voice AI beta
summary: Sonos is rolling out a major app update featuring new Presets. Users can create custom presets for music playback at specific volumes in certain rooms. Early access to its new 27voice AI assistant is also becoming available.

headline: Valve addresses ‘significant increase’ in Steam game submissions
summary: Valve acknowledges a 'significant increase' in Steam game submissions recently. Review times have extended to up to 12 business days, exceeding the typical 3-5 days. Indie developers have voiced frustrations over these prolonged approval delays.

headline: SCUF Gaming's Early Black Friday Sale: Up to 25% Off Controllers
summary: SCUF Gaming has launched an Early Black Friday Sale. Get up to 25% off professional-grade Xbox and PC controllers. These controllers offer elite form and function for gamers.

headline: 007 First Light Gets Free Trial For Select PS Plus Subscribers
summary: 007 First Light is now offering a free trial. The trial is available for select PlayStation Plus subscribers. This allows members to experience the game at no cost.

headline: AliExpress Early Black Friday Sale: 36V 500W Electric Bike for $210
summary: An adult electric bike is on sale for $210 shipped during the AliExpress Early Black Friday event. This 36V 500W peak e-bike can reach speeds up to 23mph. It boasts an impressive range of up to 45 miles.

headline: The Witcher 3 Devs Detail 'Songs of the Past' DLC
summary: CD Projekt Red discussed details for The Witcher 3's 'Songs of the Past' DLC. Developers shared insights on crafting a distinct new corner of the Continent. They also touched on the surprising importance of local booze and canon adherence.

headline: When Will Election Results Be Announced?
summary: Election results may not be projected for several hours after polls close. Some outcomes could take days or even weeks to be known. Voters face an uncertain wait for the final results.

headline: US Voters Prioritize Economy and Democracy, Poll Reveals
summary: A major election day survey indicates US voters are most concerned about the economy. The state of democracy also ranks as a top issue. Voters express unhappiness with the current economic situation.

headline: US Midterm Results Scenarios as Millions Vote
summary: Millions of Americans are heading to the polls for the US midterms. The BBC's North America correspondent outlines three potential result scenarios. Each scenario's implications for the country are explored.

headline: Key US Senate Races to Watch
summary: All eyes are on a handful of crucial US Senate races. These contests will ultimately decide control of the prized upper chamber. A quick guide highlights the most significant races to follow.
